title: Tab-bar rendering lags ~400-700ms when using custom layouts (0.44.0 regression)
body:
> Disclaimer: This bug was detected by a human programmer, but the report itself is AI-generated. I've reviewed it thoroughly, though my Zellij experience is limited. I don't want to waste open-source maintainers' time by asking you to review an AI-written report — so please let me know if more effort is needed from my side for you to look into this.

## Issue description

After upgrading from 0.43.1 to 0.44.0, switching tabs has a ~400-700ms delay before the tab-bar active indicator updates. The pane content renders instantly, only the tab-bar plugin rendering lags behind.

This ONLY occurs when using a custom layout file. A default session (no layout) with 10+ manually added tabs has no lag at all.

## Minimal reproduction

1. Save this as `test.kdl`:

    ```kdl
    layout {
        default_tab_template {
            pane size=1 borderless=true {
                plugin location="zellij:tab-bar"
            }
            children
            pane size=1 borderless=true {
                plugin location="zellij:status-bar"
            }
        }
        tab name="one" focus=true
        tab name="two"
    }
    ```

2. Start with a clean config to rule out config issues: `zellij --config-dir /tmp/zellij-clean -n test.kdl -s test`
3. Switch between tabs (Alt+Left / Alt+Right)
4. Observe: pane content switches instantly, tab-bar highlight updates ~400-700ms later

**Compare with:** `zellij -s default`, manually add 10+ tabs, switch between them — tab-bar updates instantly.

Also tested with a named `tab_template` instead of `default_tab_template` — same result. The issue is any custom layout vs no layout.

## Other relevant information

- **zellij version:** 0.44.0 (Homebrew)
- **OS:** macOS, Apple Silicon, Darwin 25.3.0
- **Not present in 0.43.1**
- Logs show `Loading plugins using Wasmi interpreter` — possibly related to the wasmtime to wasmi migration

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Nice. Could you kill all sessions on the machine, then:

1. Start one session, open a few tabs. Switch between them - is this problem still present? This is our baseline.
2. Start another session from the CLI (by just running `zellij` from another terminal window). Go back to the first session, switch between tabs. Still present? If not, start as many sessions as needed to reproduce the problem *in the first session*. Don't do anything in those sessions, just leave them open.
3. If we didn't reproduce the problem in 2, try to do the same from the session-manager (start a new session). Important though: always do this from a new window. As in: start a new terminal window, connect to the first session, open the session manager, start a new session from there. Then open a new window and repeat. Still present? After how many sessions?
4. Not reproduced yet? Now try to do 3 but from the same terminal window. Always open a new session from the session manager. In a new session, open the session manager again and open a new session from it. See when this reproduces.

Thanks you for your help!

comments.author: participant1
